sources.title: turboquant-mlx-full · PyPI
sources.snippet: turboquant-doctor runs the same projection plus a read-only readiness check — model files, tokenizer, quantization block, mlx/mlx-lm imports, machine limits — with stable check ids and exit codes (0 ok/warn, 1 won't fit or files missing, 2 bad usage).

sources.title: GitHub - bmgaf/mlx-quant
sources.snippet: Low-bit weight quantization on Apple MLX. The contribution is a matmul-decodable trellis code: a linear generator matrix makes every reproduction value linear in the code bits, so decode needs no codebook lookup and the ±1 incoherence rotation commutes through it.
